title: Normalized ringed projection and slice comparison data
statement: For essentially small ringed sites with site objects in universe u+1, site arrows in u and coefficient elements in u+1, use the existing module category and standard ordinary unbounded derived localization. A tensor model consists of the signed total tensor on flat-term K-flat representatives, a natural representative isomorphism, and full faithfulness of restriction of transformations to pairs of such representatives. Tensor shifts are the two canonical integer shifts normalized by the signed total maps. An exact model is the termwise localization with its factorization. An operation datum is the canonical exact-left and K-injective-right construction of [def-pur-ringed-module-derived-operations]. For a scheme morphism f with a specified identification f-inverse RY isomorphic to RX, a Global datum records its fixed coefficient adjunct, the canonical module and derived adjunction, two such tensor models and normalized tensor comparisons. A Local datum at V records the actual overFunctor restrictions, Over.post localization, its fixed restricted coefficient maps, identity-on-sections ordinary direct-image square, K-injective restriction, and the normalized derived square and tensor comparisons. ProjectionCompatible is the equality between restriction of the actual counit projection mate and its localized mate under the explicit source and target composites. These are the unchanged definitions previously housed with the assembly theorem.
